date_note: DHC announced the leak on November 18, which is the date used; Business+IT says PLAID told DHC of the intrusion into KARTE on November 13.
title: DHC: about 19.11 million customer records leaked via PLAID KARTE breach
summary: DHC announced on November 18 that about 19.11 million online-shop customer records leaked after unauthorized access to PLAID's KARTE marketing service; Business+IT says PLAID told DHC of the intrusion on November 13. Leaked items include names, email addresses and dates of birth; login passwords and card payment data were not included, and DHC says no misuse has been confirmed. DHC plans to report jointly with PLAID to Japan's Personal Information Protection Commission.
plain: Japanese cosmetics firm DHC says about 19 million customer records leaked through a hacked marketing platform. Passwords and card details were not included.
exec: One of the largest Japanese consumer-data leaks of the year, through a vendor rather than the company itself.
action: General advice: DHC customers should treat unexpected emails or texts using your name and birth date as phishing; change reused passwords.

evidence.quote: DHCは11月18日、外部サービス「KARTE」への第三者による不正アクセスで、顧客情報約1,911万件が外部に漏えいしたと発表した。

validation.note: NHK, Kyodo, Yomiuri and Business+IT agree on the figure and cause; the sources count records (件), not people. DHC's own PDF notice on dhc-corporate.co.jp was not opened.

review.note: NHK, Kyodo, Yomiuri confirm 19.11M, names/emails/DOB, card data excluded, no misuse; removed unsupported claims on shop passwords and PLAID Nov 13/16 dates; correction filed
